sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You emphasise both partnership and reliability; it sounds like you want a lasting relationship with Hollerau, not just an order. We want that relationship to support sustainable quality improvement, and we will ensure your invoices are paid on time.

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). We understand cash flow matters to you: we will pay every invoice reliably on the agreed day. Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (800 ppm, EUR 150 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit; 300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. We highly value your promise to pay invoices exactly on time, as reliable cash flow is crucial for us to maintain our operations. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.

To support this quality level, we can reduce our price to 46.00 EUR per unit. We present a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm: €46.00 per unit, alongside a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 2500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

We will honour our promise to pay invoices on time, while keeping prevention of recurring defects central to our partnership. How can the verified decline in electricity producer prices support a lower unit price while preserving your margin and the quality commitment you have offered?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -17.1% from 2025-02 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-02, idx:PPI-D351@2026-02). Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 96% of your invoices late, on average 10 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 10 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 43.57 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the index change data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. With your promise to pay on the due date, we can lower our price to 45.50 EUR for the 300 ppm and 0 EUR chargeback. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
